title: Pomeranian Dog Tags: 4 Pounds, 40 Opinions | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny Pomeranian dog tags, laser engraved in Lehi, Utah. Big opinions on the front, your dog's name and phone number on the back. From $12 a tag.
blurb: Engraved tags for a dog that weighs about as much as a mango and has opinions on everything. The fluff is optional. The attitude is not.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

tough.h2: Fluff eats tags. Engraving doesn't care.
tough.html:
A Pomeranian doesn't wear a tag so much as absorb it. The coat swallows it, the brushing drags across it, and a humid morning turns the whole dog into a damp cotton ball. Printed tags rub off under all that.

We cut the words into the metal instead of printing them on top. Nothing is painted on, so nothing peels off.

Survives the third pool-deck zoomie. And the fourth.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. Bulldogs bark about twice a year. Poms make up the difference. These lines are for the neighbors.

sayings.h2: 8 Pomeranian sayings for a dog that thinks it's a wolf
sayings.lead: Four pounds of hair and six pounds of conviction. They bark at leaves, mail, wind and their own reflection. Name and number go on the back.
sayings.note: Every line above fits the tag as written. Want your own? Type it in the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

Do Dog Tags Wear Off? Engraving vs. Printing, and What Actually Lasts

items.q: Will all that fur wear down the engraving?
items.a: No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on top, so brushing and constant fluff contact don't wipe them off.

items.q: Can I put my Pom's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name and your phone number are engraved on the back.

items.q: How much does a Pomeranian tag cost?
items.a: Tags start at $12. Every one is laser engraved in Lehi, Utah.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
